rationale.reason: Complete single-jersey circular knitting machines fit 8447; other knitting/weaving architectures and textile output are outside this subset.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This PCR covers manufacture of complete large-diameter single-jersey circular weft-knitting machines with declared diameter, gauge, needle/sinker mechanism, yarn feeding, drive, take-down and controls. Distinguish conventional and relative/spring-sinker layouts and actual delivered accessories. Include the complete configured machine at acceptance, with installed knitting tools, guard/frame, drive/control, feed/take-down modules and declared delivered creel. Exclude warp knitting, flat knitting, double-jersey/dial machines, seamless individual-item/hosiery machines, stitch-bonding, gimp/lace/embroidery/braid/net/tufting machines, looms and separately sold parts. CPC 44613 is broader than this boundary. Textile manufacturing in the customer mill, routine yarn consumption, fabric yield, mill utilities, maintenance/replacement needles and end-of-life are outside this manufacturing inventory. Actual factory knitting trials, test yarn, trial fabric handling and attributable utilities/lubricant/waste belong to manufacture. No textile production service or operating lifetime is included.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Complete configured large-diameter single-jersey circular weft-knitting machines
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Warp/flat/double-jersey/hosiery knitting; looms; other CPC44613 mechanisms and spare parts
reviewed_boundary.market_state: New accepted complete machine at factory gate, without yarn cones or trial fabric; packaging separately inventoried
